theme_strategy: Dark-first primary command-center aesthetic with a complete 1:1 functional light theme switch

typography.font_family_heading: Cabinet Grotesk, Manrope, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif
typography.heading_rules: Use tight letter-spacing (tracking-tight) for headings above 24px. Never use Inter for main headings or subheadings.

hierarchy.h4_card_title: text-sm sm:text-base font-semibold tracking-wide uppercase text-muted-foreground
hierarchy.small_label: text-xs font-mono font-medium tracking-wider uppercase text-muted-foreground

layout_and_grid.spacing_base: 4px grid system (p-1=4px, p-2=8px, p-3=12px, p-4=16px, p-6=24px, p-8=32px)
layout_and_grid.bento_grid_mode: MODE B: High Density Command Center Grid
layout_and_grid.anti_pattern_warning: NO generic 3-card SaaS stack. Use dynamic asymmetric density ratios (e.g., 2-col KPI strip + live feed + wide chart).

app_header_nav.desktop: Left sidebar with sticky collapsed state or top high-density command bar with live sync freshness badge, search trigger (Cmd+K), and dark/light toggle
app_header_nav.mobile: Bottom fixed navigation dock with drawer trigger for filters

tables.style: Dense tabular layout with monospace numbers, visible grid cell borders, sticky headers, inline change indicators, and row click drawer/modal detail triggers
tables.requirement: Must include search, column sorting, pagination/virtualization, and accessible table caption/summary

cards.style: Flat card surfaces with 1px border-subtle, sharp/subtle 6px corner radii (rounded-md), subtle hover background highlights, and clear section dividers

charts.style: High-contrast Recharts/Shadcn charts with custom tooltips, legend toggle, and accessible fallback tabular data modal or toggle

filters.style: Global cascading filter bar persisted in URL query parameters with active filter badges, clear-all button, and slide-over panel on mobile

motion_and_animations.philosophy: Functional micro-interactions for state transitions and tab switches. Strict prefers-reduced-motion compliance.
motion_and_animations.reduced_motion_rule: Wrap motion wrappers in motion-safe: animate classes or respect system reduced-motion query
motion_and_animations.forbidden: NO decorative continuous spinning graphics or distracting looping animations

accessibility_and_wcag.contrast_ratio: Minimum 4.5:1 for standard body text, 3:1 for large display titles and UI boundaries
accessibility_and_wcag.interactive_states: All focusable elements must feature visible outline rings (focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-primary focus-visible:ring-offset-2)
accessibility_and_wcag.status_rule: Never convey status by color alone. ALWAYS pair color with explicit icon + text label.

testing_and_testids.rule: Every interactive element, metric callout, filter input, table row, tab button, and status indicator MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

image_urls.usage_notes: Use command_center_bg sparingly as a subtle background pattern or modal backdrop if needed.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure the dashboard reads live sheet/backend mock data seamlessly with instant feedback.
Build out all required tabs: Executive Overview, TPMs, PODs Drill-down, Users Directory & Profile, Audit Workspace, Data Health.
Implement URL-persisted cascading filters for date range, TPM, POD, user search, role, work status, and workflow phase.
Always support 1:1 Dark Mode and Light Mode with flawless contrast.
Never use generic AI emojis (🤖, 💡, 🔮) for UI icons; strictly use lucide-react or @phosphor-icons/react icons.
Include data-testid on all key UI controls and metrics.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Follow dense, command-center Fluent 2 inspired layout principles. Use subtle 1px borders, high legibility monospace numbers for operational metrics, clear status badges (icon + text), and generous keyboard accessibility.
